applyTo: "**/*.{ts,tsx,cts,mts}"

# TypeScript Instructions

## Quality Gates

- All code updates must build successfully.
- All code updates must pass typechecks.
- All Vitest tests must run successfully.

## Testing

- Add Vitest unit tests when new functionality is introduced.

## Documentation

- Update documentation for every code change that affects behavior, usage, configuration, or developer workflows.
- Keep examples and CLI usage in sync with code changes.
